manual_mapping.description: Whether Tainacan must present the user with an interface to manually choose a mapping standard. This will allow them to export the items mapped to a chosen standard instead of in its original form.

manual_collection.description: Whether Tainacan will let the user choose the source collection. If set to true, Tainacan give the user a select box from where he/she will Choose one (and only one) Collection to export items from. Otherwise, the child exporter class must choose the collections somehow.

description.description: An introductory text describing the collection

slug.description: An unique and sanitized string representation of the collection, used to build the collection URL. It must not contain any special characters or spaces.

default_orderby.description: Default property that items in this collections will be ordered by

default_order.description: Default order for items in this collection. ASC or DESC

default_per_page.description: Default number of items shown per page in the public items listing of this collection.

default_displayed_metadata.description: List of collection properties that will be displayed in the table view

enabled_view_modes.description: Which visualization modes will be available for the public to choose from

enable_cover_page.description: To use this page as the home page of this collection

cover_page_id.description: If enabled, this custom page will be used as cover for this collection, instead of default items list.

header_image_id.description: The image to be used in collection header, if the theme has one.

_thumbnail_id.description: Squared reduced-size version of a picture that helps recognizing and organizing files

comment_status.description: Collection comment status: "open" means comments are allowed, "closed" means comments are not allowed.

allow_comments.description: If this option is enabled, items of this collection can be set to enable a comments section on their page. "open" means comments are allowed, "closed" means comments are not allowed.

allow_item_slug_editing.description: If this option is enabled, users will be able to modify the item original slug, resulting in changes to the item permalink.

allow_item_author_editing.description: If this option is enabled, users will be able to modify the item original authorship, resulting in changes to who can edit it and who is credited as creator of it.

submission_anonymous_user.description: If enabled, allows submission by anonymous users, whose does not have to be logged in with permissions on the WordPress system.

submission_default_status.description: The default status of the item that will be created in the collection after submission.

allows_submission.description: If enabled, the collection allows item submission, for example via the Item Submission block.

hide_items_thumbnail_on_lists.description: Enable this option to never display the item thumbnail on the items list. This is ment for collections made of mainly textual content.

submission_use_recaptcha.description: If enabled, the collection allows item submission using a reCAPTCHA

item_enabled_document_types.description: The document types that are available in the item edition form.

item_publication_label.description: The label for the publication section in the item edition form, where author, status, slug and comments options appear

item_document_label.description: The label for the main document section in the item edition form

item_thumbnail_label.description: The label for the thumbnail section in the item edition form

item_enable_thumbnail.description: If enabled, each item can have a thumbnail customized instead of the one automatically generated based on the item document.

item_attachment_label.description: The label for the attachments section in the item edition form

item_enable_attachments.description: If enabled, each item can have a set of files attached to it, complementary to the item document.

item_enable_metadata_focus_mode.description: If enabled, a button can start a special navigation mode, that focus one metadatum per time in the item edition form.

item_enable_metadata_required_filter.description: If enabled, a switch can be toggled to display only required metadata in the item edition form.

item_enable_metadata_searchbar.description: If enabled, a search bar can be used for filtering the list of metadata in the item edition form.

item_enable_metadata_collapses.description: If enabled, each metadata in the item form will be wrapped in a collapsable component.

item_enable_metadata_enumeration.description: If enabled, the metadata sections and their metadata in the item form will be enumerated automatically.

item_enable_document_content_editing.description: If enabled, the item edition form shows controls to view, extract and edit the textual content stored from item documents for use in search.
